name: Palermo 3 Seater Click Clack Sofa cum Bed in Velvet

description.mood_line: Turn your living room into a guest‑ready haven with a single, graceful click.
description.intro: The Palermo 3‑Seater Click‑Clack Sofa cum Bed blends sleek mid‑century lines with contemporary comfort.
description.story: Upholstered in plush teal‑green velvet, its engineered‑wood frame is reinforced with precision‑cut joinery and gold‑finished angled metal legs that anchor the piece with understated luxury. The three‑position click‑clack hinge lets the backrest fold forward to reveal a queen‑size sleeping platform supported by high‑resilience foam for a firm yet welcoming surface. Measuring 1.90 m × 88 cm × 82 cm as a sofa and extending to 1.90 m × 1.15 m × 42 cm as a bed, it fits snugly in studios, guest rooms, or open‑plan living areas.
description.close: Enjoy effortless hospitality and space‑saving style, day or night.

name: Karan Solid Wood Diwan Bed with Pull-Out Trundle

description.mood_line: Turn your living room into a welcoming retreat with a single touch.
description.intro: The Karan Solid Wood Diwan Bed with Pull‑Out Trundle blends classic diwan silhouette with a hidden twin trundle.
description.story: Crafted from robust sheesham wood and finished in warm walnut, the Karan showcases carved side bolster rails that echo traditional elegance while the smooth‑rolling caster trundle slides out effortlessly. Measuring 2.05 m long, 95 cm wide, and 75 cm high, it fits comfortably in living rooms, studio apartments, or guest bedrooms, offering a firm yet plush sleeping surface that welcomes overnight guests.
description.close: Invite guests in and let the Karan transform your space into a seamless sanctuary.
